question.text: The VALUE anomaly (cheap stocks outperform) challenges which form of EMH?

explanation.text: The Logic: Value = based on public fundamentals (P/E, P/B). Systematic value outperformance challenges semi-strong efficiency. The Trap: Past prices (weak-form) aren't the source of value signals. Cross-Exam Context: EMH challenges. Manager's Pro-Tip: Fama-French factor model explicitly added Value (HML) and Size (SMB) to CAPM — institutionalising the anomalies.
